text.div:
SCAN Classic (HMO)

Carrier: SCAN Health Plan. Plan type: HMO. Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

22 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 49 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document SCAN_CLASSIC_HMO_LOS_ANGELES (schema version 1.2.0).

extension.valueString: 2026 Summary of Benefits | SCAN Classic (HMO) | SCAN Prime (HMO) | Los Angeles County | January 1, 2026 – December 31, 2026
SCAN Classic (HMO) and SCAN Prime (HMO) are HMO plans with Medicare contracts. | Y0057_SCAN_21986_2026_M | 8/25 26C-SBH5425006065
Monthly Health Plan Premium | SCAN Classic: $0 | What you should know: You must continue to pay your Medicare Part B premium.
Plan Deductible | SCAN Classic: No deductible for medical. See outpatient prescription drugs section for Part D deductible.

Maximum Out-of-Pocket Responsibility (this does not include prescription drugs) | SCAN Classic: $199 | What you should know: The most you pay for copays and coinsurance for Medicare-covered medical services for the year.
OUTPATIENT PRESCRIPTION DRUGS (PART D DRUGS): SCAN CLASSIC | Part D Deductible | You pay the full cost of your Tier 3 through Tier 5 drugs until you have paid $250.
Catastrophic Coverage Stage | After your yearly out-of-pocket drug costs reach $2,100, you pay $0 for all covered prescription drugs for the remainder of the year.
Some of our network pharmacies have preferred cost-sharing. You may pay less for certain drugs if you use these pharmacies.

If you reside in a long-term care facility, your cost-sharing for a 31-day supply is the same as at a standard retail pharmacy for a 30-day supply. You may get drugs from an out-of-network pharmacy, but may pay more than you pay at an in-network pharmacy.
Who can join? | live in the plan service area (Los Angeles County, California)
SCAN Classic and SCAN Prime have a network of doctors, hospitals, pharmacies, and other providers. If you use the providers that are not in our network, the plan may not pay for these services.
Emergency Care | What you should know: You are covered for worldwide emergency services at Original Medicare reimbursable rates.
*A benefit period begins the day you go into a hospital or SNF. The benefit period ends when you haven't received any inpatient hospital or SNF care for 60 days in a row.
OPTIONAL SUPPLEMENTAL BENEFITS | DENTAL SERVICES | SCAN CLASSIC | PPO Dental Plan California | Monthly Premium | $55 per month
Comprehensive dental: oral and maxillofacial surgery
Eye exam to diagnose or treat eye disease (Medicare-covered)
Medicare Part B drugs, including chemotherapy
Part B insulin furnished through durable medical equipment
Home-delivered meals for a chronic condition
Telehealth for urgent care and mental health
